analyst.summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals grew revenue 10% in FY26 and carries a clean, low-debt balance sheet, but the last two quarters' profit numbers were both distorted by one-off items - a labour-provision charge in Q3 and a tax reversal in Q4 - that flatter the headline growth rate versus the underlying trend. Its FDA/plant record remains free of major escalations (no warning letters or import alerts on its own manufacturing sites), and it is investing in a new US branded specialty business plus a broad generics pipeline for FY27-28, but the current valuation already reflects steady, not exceptional, growth. We recommend holding existing positions without adding.
